payload.title: Delete merged Papyrus remote branches (second pass)
payload.description: 28 Papyrus remote branches are fully merged into main as of 2026-10-19 (git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/<branch> origin/main succeeds). Cloud sandbox deletion returns 403; run through Remote Control on Ryan's Mac (BlackbookM1, /Users/home/Projects/Chattic.us) with his gh credentials, re-checking ancestry first. Never delete main. The earlier pass on 2026-10-18 removed 143. Papyrus has 84 more branches with unmerged commits that belong to the Papyrus owner to triage.
